mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 0.3% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 5% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO shows a sustained 3-month decline and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM, but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 month-over-month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 MoM and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals strong consumer demand and confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and UNRATE < 5%, but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases > 2% over 3 months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of the triggered instances.
